name: po-w29
prompt:
In web/src/styles.css, directly after the `.archived-bar { ... }` rule add the PROJ-OVERVIEW styles (plain CSS, the app's custom properties only: --surface, --surface-2, --line, --fg, --fg-strong, --muted, --attn, --on-cta, --cta, --accent, --good, --bad, --radius, --mono). Calm surfaces, orange (--cta/--attn) only for "needs you"; motion only on opacity/transform, 150-200 ms.
- .overview: display grid, gap 0.75rem, margin-bottom 1rem, min-width 0.
- .ov-title: flex, align-items center, gap 0.5rem; .ov-name: margin 0, font-size 1.15rem, color var(--fg-strong), overflow-wrap anywhere; .ov-chips: flex, flex-wrap wrap, gap 0.35rem; .ov-desc: margin 0, color var(--fg); .ov-desc.muted: color var(--muted).
- .ov-tiles: display grid, grid-template-columns repeat(4, minmax(0, 1fr)), gap 0.5rem; and in a container narrower than 520px (use `@media (max-width: 760px)`) repeat(2, minmax(0, 1fr)).
- .ov-tile: grid, gap 0.15rem, padding 0.6rem 0.7rem, border 1px solid var(--line), border-radius var(--radius), background var(--surface-2), min-width 0. .ov-num: font-size 1.15rem, font-weight 600, color var(--fg-strong), white-space nowrap, overflow hidden, text-overflow ellipsis. .ov-label: font-size 0.8rem, color var(--muted). .ov-tile.attn: border-color var(--attn); .ov-tile.attn .ov-num: color var(--attn). .ov-tiles.loading .ov-num: opacity 0.5.
- .ov-bar: display block, height 4px, border-radius 2px, background var(--line), overflow hidden; .ov-bar > span: display block, height 100%, background var(--accent).
- .ov-about .md: overflow-wrap anywhere; .ov-about.clamped .md: display -webkit-box, -webkit-line-clamp 4, -webkit-box-orient vertical, overflow hidden; .ov-about.empty: flex, flex-wrap wrap, align-items center, gap 0.5rem.
- .ov-sec: border-top 1px solid var(--line); .ov-sec-head: display flex, align-items center, gap 0.4rem, width 100%, padding 0.55rem 0, min-height 44px, background none, border 0, color var(--fg-strong), font: inherit, font-weight 600, cursor pointer, text-align left; .ov-sec-head .count: margin-left auto, color var(--muted), font-weight 400; .ov-sec-body: padding-bottom 0.6rem, display grid, gap 0.4rem, min-width 0, and an @keyframes ov-in (from opacity 0, transform translateY(-4px); to opacity 1, transform none) applied to .ov-sec-body with 160ms ease-out.
- .ov-machine, .ov-git, .ov-folder-row: margin 0, display flex, align-items center, gap 0.4rem, min-width 0; .ov-folder, .ov-git span: font-family var(--mono), font-size 0.85rem, overflow-wrap anywhere, min-width 0; .dot.off: background var(--muted).
- .ov-links: margin 0, display flex, flex-wrap wrap, gap 0.35rem; .ov-links .chip: display inline-flex, align-items center, gap 0.25rem, text-decoration none.
- .ov-access, .ov-cmds, .ov-act, .ov-ai: list-style none, margin 0, padding 0, display grid, gap 0.35rem; their li: min-width 0, overflow-wrap anywhere; .ov-cmds li: display flex, flex-wrap wrap, gap 0.4rem, align-items baseline; .ov-kind: font-weight 600; .ov-act li: display grid, gap 0.1rem; .ov-when: font-size 0.8rem.
- form.overview-edit: display grid, gap 0.6rem; its label: display grid, gap 0.25rem; its input and textarea: width 100%, box-sizing border-box, font: inherit; .ov-edit-actions: display flex, gap 0.5rem; .ov-preview: padding 0.6rem, border 1px dashed var(--line), border-radius var(--radius).
Change nothing else.
